records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Learning and Development
records.description: Analysis of the connections among learning theories, human development theories, and educational practice in today's PK-12 classrooms.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Introduction to Middle Level Education
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: H D 101; TCH LRN 301.
records.description: Introduction to developmentally appropriate organization, structures, curriculum, and instruction in the middle grades.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Fundamentals of Instruction
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Introduction to lesson and unit plans, state standards, instructional models, and basic strategies for using and integrating technology.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Survey of Children's Literature
records.description: Types, values, selection of children's literature; role of teacher in facilitating children's experiences with books.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Classroom Management
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Strategies for developing positive and supportive classroom learning environments.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Initial Practicum Experience
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  TCH LRN 301.
records.description: Classroom experience providing observation, reflection and gradual classroom involvement and teaching responsibility.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Early Literacy
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Designed for pre-service teachers to link assessment and instruction and guide the development of early reading and writing skills.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Reading and Writing in Grades 4 - 8
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Designed for pre-service teachers to link assessment and instruction and assist upper-elementary students to read and write more effectively.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Literacy Assessment and Intervention
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 321.
records.description: Effective and equitable literacy assessment using research-based practices; instructional methods for assisting students who are experiencing reading difficulties and supporting students' social emotional needs and cultural identities within the literacy process.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Equity and Diversity within Schools and Communities
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 301 or concurrent enrollment; for candidates admitted to teacher education (Elementary Education).
records.description: Social, historical, and philosophical foundations of gender, socioeconomic, linguistic, and cultural diversity in schools.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Introduction to Multilingual Education
records.description: Foundations of ESL with attention to basic concepts of second language processing in educational settings.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Communication in Multilingual Classrooms and Communities
records.description: Selected topics dealing with linguistic diversity, cross-cultural communication, language development and language use.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Teaching Elementary Mathematics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 252; for candidates admitted to teacher education (EDUC).
records.description: Teaching methods, materials, and content in elementary and middle school mathematics.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Teaching Elementary Science
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Teaching methods, materials, and content in elementary and middle school science.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Teaching Elementary Social Studies
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Teaching methods, materials, and content in elementary and middle school social studies.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Integrating Fine Arts into K-8 Curriculum
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Integrating the range of fine arts (art, music, dance, drama) into K-8 curriculum; designed for preservice and inservice general K-8 teachers.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Practicum in Multilingual Education
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education or secondary education).
records.description: Work with students from diverse linguistic and cultural backgrounds in educational settings. Credit not granted for both TCH LRN 401 and 501.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Instructional Practicum I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Application of educational theories and approaches learned during methods Block I.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Linguistics for Educators
records.description: Use of linguistics to better understand second language learning and teaching and the physical aspects of acquiring a language.  Recommended preparation: TCH LRN 333, and /or TCH LRN 339, or admission to the College of Education, Sport, and Human Sciences.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Instructional Practicum II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Application of educational theories and approaches learned during methods Block II.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Curriculum and Assessment for Multilingual Education
records.description: Research in curriculum development for and assessment of language minority students.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Foundations of Multilingual Education
records.description: Theoretical foundations related to research and instructional strategies for effective schooling of language minority students. Credit not granted for TCH LRN 410 and 510.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Dual Language Teaching Methods and Materials
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 333, 339, 410, or 413.
records.description: Approaches, methods, and materials across content areas for the bilingual classroom.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Introduction to Multilingual Education in Elementary Settings
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Introduction to teaching ESL students for K-8 teachers.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Methods and Materials for Multilingual Education
records.description: Research and instructional methods related to English language acquisition across content areas. Recommended preparation:  TCH LRN 410 or 510; TCH LRN 509; TCH LRN 549. Credit not granted for both TCH LRN 414 and TCH LRN 514.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Student Teaching Internship
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education or secondary education).
records.description: To begin student teaching the candidate must have paid certification fees and have a currently valid teacher certificate application with character and fitness supplement on file; completed with a C or better all course work for the teacher certificate; received fingerprinting clearance from Washington State Patrol, FBI, and Office of Professional Practices; earned a 2.5 GPA overall, in endorsement area and professional core courses. Placement by interview only at approved sites. Supervised teaching in public schools including seminars reflecting on effective teaching and professional certification.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Computer-assisted Language Learning
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 333.
records.description: Principles of language learning with technology and application to problems of practice.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Coding for Teachers
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 445 or 466.
records.description: Elements of coding and programming for elementary and secondary classrooms. Recommended preparation: Introduction to education technology course. Credit not granted for both TCH LRN 417 and 517.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Instructional Media Production
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 333.
records.description: Principles of media design for diverse learners and application to problems of practice.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Methods of Teaching Secondary Science I
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: Junior standing.
records.description: Application of learning and theory and philosophy and structure of science in teaching middle and secondary school science courses. (Crosslisted course offered as BIOLOGY 430, MBIOS 480, TCH LRN 430.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Methods of Teaching Secondary Science II
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: BIOLOGY 430, MBIOS 480, or TCH LRN 430; junior standing.
records.description: Integration of assessment, curricular, and technological tools into instruction that aligns with learning theory and the philosophy/structure of science. (Crosslisted course offered as BIOLOGY 431, MBIOS 481, TCH LRN 431.)
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Middle Level Mathematics Methods
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite:  TCH LRN 352 or MATH 330.
records.description:
Middle-school philosophy; understanding of effective standards and research-based methods. Recommended preparation: MATH 106 (or equivalent) and MATH
251/252.  Credit not granted for both TCH LRN 433 and 533.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Conceptualization of Proportional Thinking
records.description:
Investigation of the development of K-14 students' understanding of proportional reasoning. Recommended preparation: MATH 106 (or equivalent) and MATH
251/252.  Credit not granted for both TCH LRN 434 and 534.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Indigenous Language Reclamation and Learning
records.description: Engage in hands-on language reclamation by studying one regional Indigenous language (e.g., Nez Perce language, Coeur d'Alene language, or another regional Native American language), including its linguistic and sociocultural foundations and the overarching processes and underlying tenets of Indigenous language reclamation broadly conceived. Taught or co-taught by members or regional tribes; the specific regional language offered each semester may vary depending on the availability of tribal language expert instructors. Credit not granted for both TCH LRN 435 and 535.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Elementary Methods of Educational Technology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Consideration of all technologies in K-8 schools, applications for their use, some production techniques and instructional methodologies.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Teaching Concepts of Probability and Statistics
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: MATH 252.
records.description: Development of mathematical concepts and related teaching strategies for probability and statistics, with an emphasis on middle school topics. Recommended preparation: MATH 106 (or equivalent) and MATH 251/252.  Credit not granted for both TCH LRN 463 and 563.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Curriculum, Instruction and Content Literacy Methods
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (secondary education).
records.description: Development of curriculum, instruction and content literacy materials and methods for teaching in the secondary school classroom.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Introduction to Multilingual Education in Secondary Settings
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (secondary education).
records.description: Practical knowledge for teaching ELL students in a variety of instructional contexts.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Secondary Methods of Educational Technology
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (secondary education).
records.description: Integration of technologies for teaching and learning within the 9-12 classrooms; hands-on development of technology enhanced activities and lessons.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Adolescence, Community, and School
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 317; TCH LRN 464; TCH LRN 465; for candidates admitted to teacher education (secondary education).
records.description: Understanding the socio-cultural dynamics of adolescence and youth cultures and the roles they play in secondary schools.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Pre-Internship for Secondary Teachers
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 317.
records.description: Field experience with classroom observation and teaching prior to student teaching; weekly seminar included.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Special Education, Transition, and Classroom Management for Secondary General Education Teachers
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 317; TCH LRN 464; TCH LRN 465; for candidates admitted to teacher education (secondary education).
records.description: Overview of special education topics, transition practices, and classroom management techniques for general education classrooms.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Multicultural Education in a Global Society
records.description: Multicultural and multilingual education from a global perspective; development of multicultural curriculum. (Crosslisted course offered as TCH LRN 580, CSSTE 535, MIT 552.) Credit not granted for both TCH LRN 480 and TCH LRN 580.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Integrating Health and Fitness into K-8 Curriculum
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: For candidates admitted to teacher education (elementary education).
records.description: Integrating health and fitness concepts into the K-8 curriculum; issues of abuse; designed for preservice and inservice K-8 teachers.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Global Geography
records.description: Open to non-education majors. World geography as a global perspective; education in the contemporary world: the interaction between human societies and the natural environment.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Pre-Internship for Elementary Teachers
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: TCH LRN 401 or 405; senior standing.
records.description: Intensive practicum integrating educational theory with teaching in classroom contexts.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Topics in In-Service Education
records.description: New developments and applications on selected in-service and staff development topics.

records.subject: TCH_LRN
records.title: Special Problems
records.prerequisiteText: Course Prerequisite: By department permission.
records.description: Independent study conducted under the jurisdiction of an approving faculty member; may include independent research studies in technical or specialized problems; selection and analysis of specified readings; development of a creative project; or field experiences.
records.prerequisiteReviewReason: Placement, eligibility, equivalency, credit or other non-course condition needs review.
